items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: we were doing big band swing when Jay McShann was there

ctx.x: Riverwalk, yeah. And we got into many different styles of playing, depending on a lot of times we had different guest stars and stuff — like we were doing big band swing when Jay McShann was there, we were doing all of Hootie’s big hits, which was that period, and talking about Charlie Parker and so forth. So it just depended. And all the guys on the band are great musicians and fairly — can adapt to that style. I ended up having to play saxophone more on a lot of those things too, I was playing alto and so…
Right. I think Joe Williams appeared on that.
